facts.context: Marvel’s Wolverine was a surprising miss for Sony’s first-party PlayStation game factory, but it delivers on spectacle and cinematic comic-book storylines, and it’s currently just $50, which is a very good price for a big-budget blockbuster that came out less than three months ago.
Saros, a fairly challenging 3D bullet hell shooter, is more of an acquired taste, but also easy to recommend at just $40.
At $20 a piece, they’re both a steal.
